reviews.name: Sandeep Kamath
reviews.text:
I have been using Sidhi Elder Care Services for over four months now, and I cannot recommend them highly enough.
They have supported my family through hospital admissions, doctor visits, and follow-up care, including managing prescribed medications for both my mother and my sister. For all of the above, I would rate them very highly.
What stands out most is their reliability and punctuality. They arrange pick-up for elder care patients by Uber, and they are consistently on time, organized, and caring. It has given our entire family complete peace of mind knowing our loved ones are in safe, capable hands.
If you are looking for trustworthy elder care support, Sidhi is exceptional. Highly recommended

reviews.name: Sharmila
reviews.text:
A Heartfelt Thank You to Diksha and Suraj

For the past two years, Diksha and Suraj have been a constant source of support for my parents in Mumbai. When their former company suddenly ceased operations in India, we were initially in a panic — but their reassurance that nothing would fall through the cracks meant the world to us. We were thrilled when they offered to continue caring for my mother under their own banner. Sudden disruptions like this take a significant emotional toll on seniors who fear losing familiar support, so this continuity has been invaluable.

From managing routine doctor visits to going above and beyond during emergencies, we deeply appreciate everything they have done. Thank you for maintaining regular contact with my mother and always being available for consultation.

I highly recommend Siddhi Eldercare to anyone seeking reliable, compassionate, and high-quality care services.

Thanks 🙏
